run_id.description: Optional transaction id (multi-sheet apply): recorded in the workspace journal and named by `akcli undo --run`. Auto-generated when absent.

sheets.description: Multi-sheet routing map (0.20): declares the child .kicad_sch files a 'sheet'-tagged op may target. Keys are free names referenced by per-op 'sheet' tags; each 'file' resolves relative to the draw target's directory and must already exist (`akcli new` it first). One op-list can then edit the root and its children in ONE atomic transaction (all files verify before the first write; a partial commit rolls back).

file.description: The child .kicad_sch, relative to the draw target's directory.

groups.description: Functional groups (modules). Any op may carry an optional 'group': '<NAME>' tag referencing an entry here; the op's [x, y] coordinates are then GROUP-LOCAL and akcli translates them by the group's origin before validation (absolute = local + origin). Pin anchors ('REF.PIN', 'mid()') are position-independent and never translate. Membership is persisted on placed symbols as a hidden 'Group' property.

origin.description: [x_mil, y_mil] world origin of the group's local coordinate frame.

title.description: Human-readable module title (used by group frames).

frame.description: Hint that this group wants a visual border frame (see `akcli groups frame`).

midref.description: mid(REF.PIN,REF.PIN): midpoint of two axis-aligned pins, snapped to the 50-mil grid along the wire axis.

anchorref.description: Relative-placement anchor: 'REF.PIN' (that pin's world coordinate) or bare 'REF' (the component origin). Resolved by the writer against the live document, so the anchor may be placed earlier in the SAME op-list. offset_mil is a world-frame [dx, dy] from the anchor; the result grid-snaps. Exactly one of x_mil/y_mil or anchor per op.

group.description: Optional functional-group tag; coordinates become group-local (see top-level groups).

sheet.description: Optional sheet-routing tag: apply this op to the child file the envelope's 'sheets' map declares under this key (0.20 multi-sheet envelope; absent = the draw target itself).

unit.description: Unit of a multi-unit part to place (default 1); each unit is its own instance sharing the designator.

instance_designators.description: Per-instance references for a sheet file instantiated more than once: {"<instance path>": "<REF>"} — pairwise-distinct values; 'designator' must be one of them (it seeds the uuid and is the displayed Reference). Required (INSTANCE_REFS_REQUIRED) when the target sheet has several instance paths.

oneOf.description: Position is exactly one of x_mil+y_mil (absolute) or anchor (+offset_mil, relative to a placed pin/component).
